text:
mira: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we split onboarding into two distinct phases: a cheap 'probe-only' pass and a heavyweight 'accept' pass. Probe = small adaptive budget to surface tokenizer/kv/cache/latency signals; Accept = golden evals and full regressions. Thoughts?
jordan: Sounds sensible. To be explicit: probe should run perf counters + seqlen histogram + a tiny quality smoke, while accept runs full golden comparisons and eval suites?
soufiane: Yep. Probe = 1–5k tokens, sample across seqlen buckets, include KV warmup traces. Accept = ~50–100k golden tokens + full metric suite (quality, safety, regressions).
kevin: Concern: tokenizer mismatches often show up only in probe. We need a clear short-circuit path to flag for humans instead of letting accept waste cycles. How do we signal that?
mira: Proposal: manifest-level provenance tags + explicit blocker metrics. E.g. tokenization delta > 3% => block. Example manifest snippet: ```
onboard:
  probe_budget: 5000
  accept_budget: 60000
  tokenizer_delta_blocker: 0.03
```
deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4321 to add infra-side budget caps and alerting when accept runs exceed cost thresholds :moneybag:
jordan: Also: adapt the probe budget multiplier by model pedigree. Unvetted/community models get x1.5 probe+accept multiplier; curated models get baseline. Keeps risk-based cost control.
soufiane: We should persist probe artifacts (sample inputs, seqlen histograms, KV warmup traces) to blob storage for debugging and drift analysis. Retention policy needs to balance cost vs forensics.
kevin: Another edge: quantized builds can mask regressions vs fp32. Probe should run both quantized and fp32 (when both artifacts exist) or at least a delta check between them.
mira: Action items: (1) extend onboarding manifest schema for probe/accept budgets and blockers, (2) add probe artifact retention policy and storage layout, (3) implement tokenizer-delta metric + UI blocker and automation. Who wants to own each?
jordan: I can own schema changes — will open a PR by end of day.
soufiane: I'll draft the probe artifact retention RFC and storage layout.
kevin: I'll prototype tokenizer-delta metric and add unit tests against a few tokenizers.
mira: Thanks all :thumbsup:. If anyone sees other edge-cases (ensembles, caching-only endpoints, models with custom tokenizers) ping here and we'll fold them into the schema before landing.
